verdict.rationale: ernd is a business card with an app for rewards and card requests. A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for this kind of fintech or expense product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers cashback on AI vendors, partner rewards and the card-request flow, with nothing showing an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Earning rewards on AI spend is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
